info.title: MartHub API
info.description: Implemented foundation, authentication, account, public catalog, Admin operations, and authenticated cart read/add endpoints. Future inventory: docs/API.md.

post.description: Idempotently revoke the cookie family, including rotated successors.
Revoke all families for the authenticated user.

get.description: Return the authenticated customer's current safe profile.

patch.description: Update the authenticated customer's name and optional phone. Email, role, status and identity fields are immutable here.

post.description: Create an owned address. The first active address becomes default; an explicit isDefault replaces the current default atomically.

patch.description: Update allowed fields on one owned, non-archived address. Default changes use the dedicated command.

delete.description: Archive one owned address and remove its default flag.

put.description: Atomically make one owned, non-archived address the sole default.

post.description: Email is trimmed/lowercased, names trimmed, passwords preserve whitespace and use Argon2id. Public registration cannot select role/status. Limits: 100 attempts/IP and 10/email per 15 minutes.
Email is trimmed/lowercased, names trimmed, passwords preserve whitespace and use Argon2id. Public registration cannot select role/status. Limits: 100 attempts/IP and 10/email per 15 minutes.
No body or empty JSON object. 300 attempts/IP/15 minutes. Atomic rotation; replay revokes the family including concurrent successors.

get.description: List active top-level categories and active direct children in stable order. Query options are not accepted.
Return an active category with active children and an active parent, when present.
Search active, priced products by name, brand, or SKU; filter, sort, and paginate with deterministic tie breakers. Category includes direct children. All prices are VND integer strings.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Normalized 2-80 character search text; all space-separated terms must match name, brand, or SKU.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Active category slug; includes products in its direct children.

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Inclusive current price in VND; must not be less than minPrice.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Defaults to relevance when q is present, otherwise newest. Relevance requires q.

get.description: Return active product detail with current VND price, ordered images, and stock availability.
Return bounded active promotions, active top-level categories, current-price deals, new products, and popular products using one database-time snapshot.
Authorize the current database-backed Admin session and return only its safe identity projection.
List active and archived categories for administration.

post.description: Create an active top-level or child category.

get.description: Retrieve one active or archived category.

patch.description: Update allowed category content, parent placement, or display order. Public slugs are immutable.

post.description: Archive a category after confirming it has no active child categories.

get.description: Search, filter, and paginate draft, active, and archived products for administration.

post.description: Create a draft product with an initial exact VND price and zero stock.

patch.description: Update allowed catalog fields. SKU, slug, price, inventory, and status use immutable or dedicated commands.

post.description: Publish a valid draft product assigned to an active category.
Archive a product without deleting catalog or commercial records.
Create a product-bound, five-minute signed Cloudinary upload contract for JPEG, PNG, or WebP source images up to 4 MB.
Register a signed upload only after the API verifies authoritative provider metadata and product ownership.

patch.description: Update alternative text, display order, or primary-image selection for a product image.

delete.description: Remove the image from MartHub and durably track retry-safe provider cleanup. Returns 202 while cleanup remains pending or failed.

202.description: Provider asset cleanup remains durable for retry.

get.description: List immutable price history newest first, including actor and database-time current state.

post.description: Atomically close the latest open predecessor and create its actor-attributed open-ended successor. Middle insertion and timeline rewriting are rejected.

get.description: Search and paginate single-location product inventory, optionally applying an inclusive low-stock ceiling.
List append-only inventory movements newest first with authoritative before and after quantities.

post.description: Atomically apply a non-zero signed delta and append the Admin actor, reason, and quantity boundaries.

201.description: Inventory adjustment committed with its movement.

200.description: Promotion media removed or cleanup scheduled.

get.description: Return the authenticated Customer active cart without creating one, reconciled against current public catalog price and availability.

200.description: Current active cart or an empty cart representation.

post.description: Create or increment one product row in the authenticated Customer active cart. The resulting line quantity must remain within 1-99 and is not clamped or reserved against inventory.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Invalid values are replaced with a generated UUID.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly equal WEB_ORIGIN. HTTPS required in production.

AuthLoggedOut.description: Revocation committed; cookie cleared. No response body.

Set-Cookie.example: mh_refresh=; Path=/api/v1/auth; Expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax

AuthError.description: Normalized error: INVALID_CREDENTIALS/UNAUTHORIZED (401), ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED (403), EMAIL_IN_USE (409), VALIDATION_ERROR (422).

AuthRateLimited.description: RATE_LIMITED: shared PostgreSQL attempt budget exceeded.

AuthSession.description: Access token lifetime is 900 seconds. Keep access tokens in browser memory. No refresh token or password hash in JSON.

Set-Cookie.description: Host-only mh_refresh; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax; Path=/api/v1/auth; Secure in production; 30-day expiry. Refresh 401 clears this cookie.
Set-Cookie.example: mh_refresh=REDACTED; Path=/api/v1/auth; Expires=Wed, 14 Oct 2026 00:00:00 GMT; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax

AddressResult.description: Owned address result without user ID or archival metadata.

BearerAuth.description: Active session and current database user status/role required.

RefreshCookie.name: mh_refresh
RefreshCookie.description: Rotated opaque token. Only SHA-256 hashes are persisted; replay revokes the family.
